name: Analyze player achievements by position and nationality
sql:
SELECT position, nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count, 
       AVG(nba_championships) AS avg_championships,
       AVG(mvp_awards) AS avg_mvp
FROM player
WHERE position IS NOT NULL AND nationality IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY position, nationality
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
reason: Multi-level grouping with multiple aggregations and HAVING clause on large dataset
